newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vebacom seeks expert input into telecoms watchdog.
newsitem.headline: Vebacom seeks expert input into telecoms watchdog.

text.p: German telecommunications group Vebacom GmbH on Wednesday called for the establishment of a commission of experts to advise the government on setting up a planned German telecoms watchdog.
"That is the only way for the market regulator to become a powerful organisation," said Ulf Bohla, Vebacom's managing director.
Bohla said the proposed commission should start coming up with suggestions on how best to organise and operate the new watchdog body.
He said he expected the new regulator to create fair and operational competitive structures within which Germany's telecoms companies could work.
This was particularly important, Bohla said, as imminent new legislation governing the German telecommunications market did not contain any specific regulations on competitive structures.
"The regulating body has to set out the room for manoeuvre for the industry. Only then will the telecommunications law be a success," said Bohla.
